name: BRCA1 associated RING domain 1

function.text: BARD1 encodes BRCA1-associated RING domain protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein heterodimerization activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in DNA repair and homologous recombination.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include BARD1-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); hereditary breast carcinoma (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
